post.summary: createStaffLogin
post.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Provisions a brand-new, EMAIL-LESS staff login (external account + platform identity + provider binding + active membership + initial role+scope assignment) in one step — the onboarding path for POS floor staff who have no email. The provider subject is minted by the server and never accepted from the client. The assigned role must be a subset of the caller's own tenant-wide permissions (anti-escalation). Exact replay returns the original response; changed intent conflicts.

requestBody.description: New login to provision and link.

get.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant. Resolves an existing account by EXACT email (case-insensitive, trimmed) so a manager can add it as staff — this is a confirmation lookup, NOT a browsable directory: there is no display-name, partial, substring, or wildcard search, and no pagination. Returns already-provisioned, active identities that do not yet hold a membership in this tenant, with a minimal projection; never reveals other tenants' membership relationships. An unknown email, an inactive identity, and an already-a-member identity are indistinguishable (all return an empty list). Because primary_email is not unique, the response is an explicit 0..N list ordered by identity id ascending (bounded to 50 exact matches): 0 items = no eligible account; 1 item = an unambiguous account; more than 1 = multiple provisioned identities share the exact email, and the client MUST require explicit selection and MUST NOT silently choose one (the server never collapses or prefers a match). Does not create identities or send invitations.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Exact email of the existing account to link (trimmed, case-insensitive).

get.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant. The canonical catalog of EXISTING roles in the caller's own tenant that may be selected for a Role+Scope assignment — use it instead of deriving options from assignments other staff already hold. Read-only: it creates, edits and deletes nothing, and role/permission authoring remains out of scope. Archived roles are excluded (assignment rejects them). Anti-delegation: a role appears only when every active permission it carries is already held by the caller tenant-wide — the same subset rule the assignment write enforces. The filter is a convenience, NOT the authorization boundary: POST /role-assignments re-runs the check independently, so knowing a role id grants nothing and no role name is ever interpreted. Ordered by role name ascending.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum items per page (1-100, default 25).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque forward-pagination cursor from a previous page's nextCursor.

get.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant. The canonical catalog of EXISTING active access scopes in the caller's own tenant that may be selected for a Role+Scope assignment. Read-only: scope and scope-target authoring remains out of scope. Scopes are NOT filtered against the caller because a scope carries no authority of its own — it only narrows where an assigned role's permissions apply, and the role is already subset-filtered. Explicit scopes project their existing targets (brand / branch / warehouse / inventory_location) with the display name read from the referenced record; no label is invented and every target is tenant-bound by composite foreign key. Tenant-mode scopes have no targets. Ordered by scope name ascending.

post.summary: assignStaffRole
post.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Assigns an existing tenant role + access scope to the membership. Anti-escalation: the role's permission set must be a subset of the caller's own current tenant-wide permissions.

put.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Sets or rotates the staff member's OFFLINE-unlock PIN — a credential independent of their Clerk online password — used by the POS offline cashier when the device has no connection. The PIN is sealed server-side (AES-256-GCM) and never stored or returned in plaintext; the offline bootstrap later emits a device-bound scrypt verifier derived from it. Anti-escalation: the target's held permissions must be a subset of the caller's own tenant-wide permissions. Returns 503 when the server has no offline-PIN key configured.

delete.description: Requires a tenant-wide staff.manage grant and Idempotency-Key. Revokes an active assignment (history-preserving; never deleted). Cannot strand the tenant's last active staff.manage membership.

Idempotency records are retained indefinitely (minimum guaranteed queue window: 365 days).

post.summary: Ingest a customer installment paydown already accepted offline.
post.description: Device-authenticated ingestion verifies canonical Ed25519 intent and the grant binding, then applies the paydown idempotently against the customer's outstanding balance. Idempotency records are retained indefinitely (minimum guaranteed queue window: 365 days).

requestBody.description: Signed immutable offline customer payment command.

clerkSessionToken.description: Clerk session token presented as a Bearer credential.

TenantIdHeader.name: X-Tenant-Id
TenantIdHeader.description: The tenant the request operates within.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Caller-stable idempotency key for the write. A replay with the same key and body is not applied twice; the same key with a different body is rejected with a 409.

Error409.description: The request conflicts with current state.

Error413.description: The export exceeds the maximum row count.
